## Pakete laden

```{r}
library(dada2)
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(phyloseq)

# Konflikte explizit lösen (zwischen dplyr und phyloseq)
filter <- dplyr::filter
count  <- dplyr::count
```

## Pfade definieren

```{r}
base_path <- "C:/Users/user/Documents/Master_EnvironmentalSciences/Master_Thesis"
```



## Ergebnisse aufbereiten

```{r}
# Taxonomy-Matrix einlesen (auf KIT-Server berechnet: assign_taxonomy_all.R)
taxonomy_df <- read.csv(file.path(base_path, "Data/Final/Taxonomy/taxonomy_all.csv"))
# X-Spalte als Zeilenname setzen

rownames(taxonomy_df)<- taxonomy_df$sequence

# Prüfen
head(rownames(taxonomy_df))  # Sequenzen zeigen
head(colnames(taxonomy_df))  # Kingdom, Phylum, ... 

# Überblick
cat("Klassifizierte ASVs gesamt:", nrow(taxonomy_df), "\n\n")

cat("Klassifizierungsrate pro Ebene:\n")
for (rank in c("Kingdom", "Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", "Genus", "Species")) {
  n <- sum(!is.na(taxonomy_df[[rank]]))
  cat(sprintf("  %-10s %4d / %d  (%.1f%%)\n",
              rank, n, nrow(taxonomy_df), 100 * n / nrow(taxonomy_df)))
}
```

## Verteilung der Phyla

```{r}
taxonomy_df |>
  filter(!is.na(Phylum)) |>
  count(Phylum, sort = TRUE) |>
  mutate(Phylum = fct_reorder(Phylum, n)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = n, y = Phylum)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#2c7bb6") +
  labs(
    title = "ASVs pro Phylum",
    x = "Anzahl ASVs",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
```

## Verteilung der Klassen (Top 15)

```{r}
taxonomy_df |>
  filter(!is.na(Class)) |>
  count(Class, sort = TRUE) |>
  slice_head(n = 15) |>
  mutate(Class = fct_reorder(Class, n)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = n, y = Class)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#abd9e9") +
  labs(
    title = "Top 15 Klassen",
    x = "Anzahl ASVs",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
```


## ASV-Tabelle mit Taxonomie zusammenführen für Erstellung von phylosec-Datei

```{r}
# OTU-Tabelle direkt aus seqtab_all
OTU <- otu_table(t(seqtab_all), taxa_are_rows = TRUE)

# Taxonomie-Tabelle
taxonomy_df <- read.csv(file.path(base_path, "Data/Final/Taxonomy/taxonomy_all.csv"))
rownames(taxonomy_df) <- taxonomy_df$sequence
TAX <- tax_table(as.matrix(taxonomy_df[, c("Kingdom", "Phylum", "Class",
                                            "Order", "Family", "Genus", "Species")]))

# phyloseq Objekt
ps <- phyloseq(OTU, TAX)

# ── Sample-Namen bereinigen ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
clean_names <- rownames(seqtab_all)

# Nur EC24_245 bereinigen
clean_names <- sub("^ns2024-18-", "", clean_names)
clean_names <- ifelse(
  grepl("^ns2024|^EC24", clean_names) & grepl("_S\\d+_L001$", clean_names),
  sub("_S\\d+_L001$", "", clean_names),
  clean_names
)
clean_names <- gsub("-", "_", clean_names)

# Nur Popa bereinigen
clean_names <- ifelse(
  grepl("^Popa", clean_names),
  sub("_S\\d+_L001$", "", clean_names),
  clean_names
)

sample_names(ps) <- clean_names

# Check
cat("Nicht gefunden:\n")
print(sample_names(ps)[!sample_names(ps) %in% rownames(metadata)]) # --> Die Negativcontrollen (NC) sind nicht in den Metadaten, alle anderen schon
```

# Labor-Label und Käferart mergen

```{r}
# Metadaten mergen
metadata_filtered <- metadata[rownames(metadata) %in% sample_names(ps), , drop = FALSE]
cat("Proben mit Metadaten:", nrow(metadata_filtered), "\n")

sample_data(ps) <- sample_data(metadata_filtered)
View(sample_data(ps))
# Negativkontrollen entfernen
ps <- subset_samples(ps, !is.na(beetle_species))
cat("Proben nach NC-Entfernung:", nsamples(ps), "\n")
ps
```
# Speichern

```{r}
saveRDS(ps, file.path(base_path, "Data/Final/phyloseq_all.rds"))
```
